question: What is the Resulticks acquisition supposed to unlock — revenue synergies or cost savings?

beats.line: Diginex's Resulticks deal is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.
beats.headline: REVENUE SYNERGY
events: A single paper document drops onto empty violet ground, opening cold.
A rubber stamp swings down and marks the document's face.
A black paper chip slaps in beside it as the document settles.
beats.delivery: [presenting to camera] Diginex's Resulticks deal is a revenue synergy play, not cost savings.

beats.line: The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data capabilities.
beats.headline: $1.5B
events: The document, already in place, is joined by stacked paper sheets sliding in from the edge.
The sheets layer onto the document one by one, thickening it.
A large black chip slaps in, the figure printing big.
beats.delivery: [excited] The one point five billion dollar deal adds AI customer data capabilities.

beats.line: It turns a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.
beats.headline: END-TO-END
events: The violet chips slide off the top edge as the ground turns cyan and a paper platform slab enters.
Torn strips tape themselves across the slab, joining its edges into one piece.
A black chip slaps in at the slab's corner.
beats.delivery: It turns a point solution into an integrated end-to-end platform.

beats.line: Now two workflows: sustainability compliance, and customer intelligence and marketing.
beats.headline: 2 WORKFLOWS
events: The platform slab holds position as two stencilled arrows enter from opposite edges.
The arrows split outward across the slab, tracing two separate paths.
A black chip slaps down between them, the first chip staying put.
beats.delivery: Now two workflows: sustainability compliance, and customer intelligence and marketing.

beats.line: Enterprises buy both from one vendor, increasing wallet share.
beats.headline: WALLET SHARE
events: The slab and its arrows stay exactly where they are as paper coins enter from below.
A paper hand slides the coins along both arrows into the slab.
A black chip slaps in over the coin pile.
beats.delivery: Enterprises buy both from one vendor, increasing wallet share.

beats.line: The risk is integration complexity across four distinct acquisitions.
beats.headline: 4 ACQUISITIONS
events: The cyan chips flip away as the ground turns magenta and four hole-punched tags drop in.
String and pins thread between the tags, tangling as they connect.
A black chip slaps in beneath the tangle.
beats.delivery: [fast-paced] The risk is integration complexity across four distinct acquisitions.

beats.line: Costs rose three point four million, to eight point one million.
beats.headline: $8.1M G&A
events: The tagged tangle stays in place as a paper bar chart rises beside it.
The bar climbs upward in torn increments until it towers.
A black chip slaps in at the bar's top edge.
beats.delivery: Costs rose three point four million, to eight point one million.

beats.line: Two point two million came from merger and acquisition legal work.
beats.headline: $2.2M LEGAL
events: The paper bar holds as a stack of legal documents slides in at its base.
A paper hand taps the stack, and a slice of the bar shades to match.
A black chip slaps in over the shaded slice.
beats.delivery: Two point two million came from merger and acquisition legal work.

beats.line: Watch for cross-sell traction from Resulticks' customer base.
beats.headline: CROSS-SELL TRACTION
events: The magenta chips are covered as the ground returns to violet and the document reappears.
A stencilled arrow enters and sweeps across the document, accelerating.
A paper hand presses the arrow flat as a black chip lands.
beats.delivery: Watch for cross-sell traction from Resulticks' customer base.

beats.line: Without that, it's financial engineering rather than a strategic unlock.
beats.headline: STRATEGIC UNLOCK
events: The document, already in place, is joined by a paper key — the one new element in this closing shot.
The key turns slowly against the document's edge and stops halfway.
A black chip slaps in over the document, closing where we began.
beats.delivery: Without that, it's financial engineering rather than a strategic unlock.
